entities.name: Boron tribromide
observations: BBr3 is represented by [Br][B]([Br])[Br] and functions as a Lewis-acidic demethylation reagent.
In this reaction it is not a coupling partner.

entities.name: Dichloromethane
observations: [Cl][C][Cl] represents dichloromethane, used as solvent rather than a reaction substrate.

entities.name: Methoxy heteroaryl substrate
observations: The substrate is represented as COc1ccc(-c2nsnc2Cl)cc1, a 4-methoxyphenyl-substituted chlorinated 1,2,5-thiadiazole-like heteroaryl compound.
Its aryl methyl ether is the reactive functional group; the heteroaryl C–Cl bond is retained.

entities.name: Hydroxy heteroaryl product
observations: The proposed product is Oc1ccc(-c2nsnc2Cl)cc1, formed by replacing the aryl methoxy group with a hydroxy group.
The transformation is BBr3-mediated O-demethylation; no C–C or C–heteroatom cross-coupling occurs.
